pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with sharp to moderately softened edge gradients. Patches on the flank exhibit larger spatial area and higher angularity compared to the smaller, more densely packed patches on the shoulder and lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored negative space pathways. Junction nodes primarily feature tri-radiate and quadri-radiate intersections. Pathway thickness is narrow and relatively uniform, though slight widening is observed at the vertices of larger flank patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a consistent serrated 1D silhouette along the upper neck with low-amplitude, high-frequency vertical projections against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an avian symbiont perched on the upper dorsal neck/shoulder region near the mane.
